510f16a5a20a21f7.description: About the Role Anotech is seeking a Security Systems Commissioning Engineer for a contract position in Tabuk, specifically covering Duba and Tabuk. This role is central to the Green Hydrogen Project, focusing on the coordination, verification, documentation, and operational handover of physical security systems during the Commissioning and Start-Up (CSU) phase. The engineer will also support the transition to an operator-owned security model in early operations. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to integrate vendor testing, HCIS/SAIS evidence, security operations readiness, training, defect closeout, and sustainable ownership of technical security systems. The position operates within a live mega-project environment, managing the transition from system completion and commissioning into start-up, performance demonstration, handover, and early operations support. Key Responsibilities Lead the coordination, verification, documentation, and operational handover of assigned physical security systems. Coordinate across Engineering, Construction, Quality, EHS, Operations, the client, specialist vendors, and subcontractors, ensuring clear technical and safety accountabilities. Manage commissioning readiness, test coordination, completion evidence, punch-list closure, turnover quality, and operational handover for the assigned discipline. Provide field leadership and disciplined documentation to support "Proof of Compliance" while vendors and contractors perform equipment-specific testing, programming, configuration, energization, and troubleshooting. Support temporary operating arrangements, reliability runs, defect resolution, training, spares and warranty interfaces, and stabilization during early operations. Cover assigned systems including access control, CCTV, video management, intrusion detection, security intercom, ALPR, turnstiles and gates, security networks, PSIM, radar, sonar, and other integrated perimeter or building-security systems. Support the transition from EPC-delivered security arrangements to operating-organization ownership, including control-room interfaces, procedures, competency, maintenance readiness, and compliance evidence. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in security systems commissioning. Demonstrated experience in coordinating complex technical systems within large-scale projects. Proficiency in managing documentation for compliance and operational handover. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities spanning Duba and Tabuk. The role involves working within a dynamic mega-project environment, requiring coordination with various stakeholders and a focus on transitioning systems from commissioning to operational phases. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

USA), is seeking an Operations Supervisor for its manufacturing plant in Jeddah, Makkah Province. This full-time role is essential for overseeing daily manufacturing workflows and ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and efficiency across premium bedding lines. Role Overview The Operations Supervisor will manage day-to-day manufacturing floor operations and coordinate multi-cultural production crews. The position involves leveraging ERP infrastructure to meet daily production targets. Candidates should possess an engineering mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and specialized experience in manufacturing systems. Key Responsibilities Coordinate, assign daily shifts, and monitor technicians and line operators to safely achieve production quotas. Manage operational directives on the floor to maximize machinery output, including automated sewing, pocket spring lines, and tape-edge machines. Utilize Odoo ERP (Manufacturing and Inventory modules) to trace materials, process logs, and track shift performance metrics. Coordinate with maintenance, procurement, and logistics teams to mitigate raw material shortages and plan scheduled downtime. Uphold stringent safety protocols and corporate quality benchmarks across all production lines. Proficiency in using ERP systems, specifically Odoo (Manufacturing and Inventory modules), for tracking and reporting. Strong understanding of manufacturing systems and workflow optimization. Ability to ensure adherence to quality and safety standards. Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional coordination. 5196212cf15e313c.company_name: مركز سمير محمد علي عباس الطبي فرع شركة الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس وشركاه
5196212cf15e313c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الهلال الذهبي الطبية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يمثل هذا الدور نقطة الاتصال الأولى للزوار والعملاء، ويتطلب شخصًا قادرًا على إدارة الاستقبال بكفاءة وتقديم الدعم الإداري اللازم. هذه فرصة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة أو بدون خبرة سابقة (0-1 سنة) لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات الضرورية. إعلام المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات العامة، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة أو تنسيق المهام. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات والاجتماعات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك بدقة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة مهام متعددة. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب الأساسية (مثل Microsoft Office). المرونة والقدرة على التكيف مع بيئة العمل المتغيرة. نوع الوظيفة هذه وظيفة بدوام كامل في شركة الهلال الذهبي الطبية، وتوفر بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

51f4f4f6d4088ccc.description: Organization- Miraval The Red Sea Summary The Yoga and Meditation Instructor at Miraval The Red Sea is responsible for leading transformative movement-based experiences that integrate mindful movement, breathwork, meditation, and holistic fitness practices. This role supports guests in achieving physical, mental, and emotional well-being through personalized and group sessions, including yoga, meditation, Pilates, tai chi, Qi Gong, breathwork, and other mindful movement modalities. The instructor will create a safe, inspiring, and engaging environment that promotes inner balance and self-discovery while adhering to Saudi Arabia’s hospitality and wellness industry standards. The ideal candidate will collaborate with the Wellness team to create integrated programs that enhance the guest experience. Key Responsibilities: Program Delivery & Guest Experience: Lead group and private sessions in yoga, meditation, tai chi, breathwork, Qi Gong, sound healing, pilates, and other mindful movement modalities, tailoring the experience to guest needs. Guide guests through personalized movement-based programs, focusing on strength, flexibility, mindfulness, and inner balance. Deliver educational workshops on posture, movement awareness, stress reduction, and energy balancing techniques. Ensure a welcoming, inclusive, and culturally respectful environment for all guests, addressing diverse backgrounds, physical abilities, and wellness goals. Align all movement sessions with Miraval’s mindfulness-based approach to well-being, incorporating elements of self-discovery, emotional health, and transformation. Operational Excellence & Compliance: Maintain the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and guest service, ensuring that all activities are conducted with care and attention to detail. Oversee the proper use, maintenance, and cleanliness of movement spaces and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional environment. Immediately report any issues to the relevant department. Ensure all practices comply with Saudi Arabia’s health, wellness, culture and hospitality regulations. Collaborate with the Wellness team to integrate movement practices into broader well-being programs, creating an immersive guest experience. Professional Development & Innovation: Stay updated with the latest research, trends, and best practices in mindful movement, fitness, and holistic wellness practices. Continuously refine teaching techniques and program offerings to meet the evolving needs of guests, ensuring high-quality experiences and increase in revenue. Actively contribute to team meetings, training sessions, and cross-functional collaborations within the resort, ensuring alignment with Miraval’s values and standards. Guest Engagement & Marketing: Actively contribute to marketing initiatives, providing content such as articles, blog posts, and promotional materials to highlight movement-based offerings at Miraval The Red Sea. Foster strong guest relationships by providing personalized, memorable experiences, and actively contribute to maintaining high guest satisfaction and positive reviews across social media and feedback platforms. Qualifications Certified instructor in Yoga (RYT-200/500), Pilates, Tai Chi, Qi Gong, or other relevant mindful movement disciplines. Minimum 2 years of experience teaching at a luxury wellness resort, retreat center, or holistic health setting. Strong understanding of movement mechanics, breathwork, mindfulness, and mind-body integration. Experience working with diverse guest needs, including beginners, advanced practitioners, and those with physical limitations or specific wellness goals. Proficiency in English (knowledge of Arabic is a plus). Ability to create a calming, nurturing, and inspiring class environment that promotes relaxation, focus, and personal transformation. Skills & Abilities: Exceptional communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to engage and inspire guests of all backgrounds and experience levels. Ability to adapt sessions and classes to meet the individual needs and goals of guests, ensuring a tailored experience. Empathetic, patient, and responsive to guest needs, creating a supportive and empowering environment. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring a smooth, seamless operation of all movement-based offerings. Proficiency in digital tools such as email, word processing, and spreadsheets for program management and communication. Compensation & Benefits: Competitive tax-free salary based on experience and industry standards. Accommodation provided by the resort. Full medical insurance as per Saudi labor laws. Flight allowance and paid vacation. Career growth within the Hyatt/Miraval brand.

514711bbd3d27e14.description: Position Overview Boeing Global Services is seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join the Supply Chain Execution organization. This full-time role is primarily based in Riyadh Region, specifically Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with Jeddah also considered as a secondary location. The selected candidate will function as a Customer Program Manager, supporting customers across the Middle East and Africa regions. Key Responsibilities Create, maintain, and advance customer relationships, developing an understanding of customer culture and business strategies. Interact with customers and internal partners through face-to-face/virtual meetings, phone calls, emails, and other media. Manage customer account health and provide customer support. Collaborate with customers to determine specific needs and recommend potential solutions, involving internal partners as required. The role requires minimal travel, both domestically and internationally, to support customer needs. 514afdb45bbf04e2.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Electrical BIM Modeler to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing, coordinating, and managing detailed 3D BIM models for electrical systems, ensuring compliance with project requirements and BIM standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Electrical BIM Modeler is responsible for creating models that encompass power distribution, lighting, low current systems, and fire alarm layouts. A key aspect of this role is ensuring clash-free coordination with other disciplines and maintaining adherence to established BIM standards and the project's specific requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed BIM models for electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, low current, and fire alarm systems. Model electrical components such as LV panels, distribution boards, cabling, routing, and containment systems. Prepare shop drawings, coordinated drawings, and as-built documentation from BIM models. Perform clash detection using Navisworks and coordinate with other disciplines to resolve conflicts. Coordinate electrical systems with architectural, structural, and MEP models to ensure integrated design. Ensure models comply with project BIM standards, BIM Execution Plan (BEP), and ISO 19650 requirements. Maintain the required Level of Development (LOD 300–400) across all electrical models. Extract quantities, Bill of Quantities (BOQs), material take-offs, and cable schedules from models. Update models based on design revisions, RFIs, and site instructions. Maintain proper file structure, naming conventions, and workflows within the Common Data Environment (CDE). Participate in coordination meetings and support the resolution of technical and design issues. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 4-8 years of experience in a similar role, demonstrating proficiency in BIM modeling for electrical systems. A strong understanding of BIM standards and coordination processes is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Electrical BIM Modeler will work collaboratively within a project team, engaging with various disciplines to ensure integrated and coordinated designs.

5180f6da5d482fdf.description: About the Role Legacy Hotels Holding is seeking an experienced Finance Manager for Tulip Inn Al Daar Rawafid, a franchised hotel located in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the hotel’s financial strategy, including budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and financial controls. Role Context and Objectives The Finance Manager will work closely with the General Manager and the hotel’s ownership and leadership teams. The primary objective is to safeguard the hotel’s assets and drive profitability. This is achieved through accurate financial reporting, effective cash flow and cost management, strong internal controls, and providing sound financial guidance to support strategic decision-making. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the hotel's financial strategy, ensuring alignment with company objectives. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning to meet financial goals. Provide financial guidance and recommendations to the General Manager and senior management. Prepare and analyze financial statements, identifying trends and variances. Monitor financial performance, highlighting areas for improvement or cost-saving opportunities. Maintain accurate and timely financial records, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Collaborate with various departments to evaluate and optimize business processes. Conduct feasibility studies and financial analysis for potential projects or investments. Assist in business development efforts and strategic decision-making. Manage cash flow and liquidity, ensuring funds are available for operational needs. Implement effective treasury and cash management practices. Identify financial risks and implement risk mitigation strategies. Ensure compliance with financial regulations, company policies, and industry standards. Facilitate internal and external audits as needed. Manage and develop a finance and business support team, fostering a culture of excellence. Provide training and mentorship to colleagues to enhance financial knowledge and skills. Implement cost-control measures while maintaining quality and service standards. Oversee procurement processes, negotiating vendor contracts and optimizing supplier relationships. Stay updated on financial technology trends and recommend system improvements. Ensure the efficient use of financial systems and tools. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant finance role. Demonstrated ability to lead financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. Strong understanding of financial controls and asset safeguarding. Work Environment and Safety The Finance Manager is expected to operate in a safe and environmentally friendly manner, prioritizing the health and safety of guests and colleagues, as well as environmental conservation. Adherence to hotel environmental, health, and safety procedures and policies is required. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Key Responsibilities Promote and sell workshop services for rotating equipment, including repair, overhaul, and maintenance of pumps, compressors, turbines, and gearboxes. 519e5d6339f461c6.description: About the Role We are recruiting a Community and General Entertainment Integration Manager to join a dedicated, full-time team embedded in our client’s Festival Programming function in Riyadh. The team will support two major events in Saudi Arabia: a multi-week project in summer 2027 (July to August) and a further event in November 2027 . You will be the festival programmer for the wider audience, not just dedicated fans. You will fill the festival’s shared spaces with: Main stage shows Fan zones Family activities Weekly highlight moments Exclusive content Because the festival runs for several weeks, you will keep refreshing the line-up so the programme stays fresh from the first day to the last. For every format, you will tell the planning and operations teams in advance how many people it will draw and what space and staff it needs. This is a hands-on producing role. The grade reflects your seniority and judgement, not the size of a team you supervise. We are looking for a programmer who personally builds the calendars, rotations and main stage programmes. Key Responsibilities Common Area Programming Programme the festival’s common areas, including the main stage and entertainment, weekly moments and hero content. Work closely with the Masterplan team, which owns the physical common area spaces, so that programming and space planning stay fully aligned. Create a main stage programme that draws audiences and gives the festival its signature moments. Community and General Entertainment Programme community activity, including fan zones, community activities, family and general entertainment, rotating content and exclusive moments. Make sure the programme appeals to a broad audience, including families, casual visitors and dedicated fans. Build moments that encourage repeat visits throughout the festival season. Content Rotation and Season Planning Plan content rotations so the programme evolves across a multi-week season. Develop multi-week programming calendars that balance consistency with novelty. Schedule weekly highlights and exclusives to keep audience interest and momentum high. Operational Integration Give planning teams the throughput, space and staffing implications of every programme format well in advance. Work with the operations, masterplan and crowd management teams so that every programmed activity can be delivered safely and effectively. Turn creative programming ideas into clear operational requirements. Programme Control Maintain the live programme change log, making sure every update is tracked and communicated to the relevant teams. Keep the programme accurate, current and aligned across all workstreams throughout the planning and live periods. At least 8 years of experience in entertainment, community or festival programming for large-scale live events, at Senior Manager level. Experience across at least two live event seasons. A proven record of personally producing multi-week programming calendars, content rotations and main stage programmes. Only experience where you personally produced the work counts towards the requirement. Ideal Background A festival or entertainment programmer from large, multi-week events. Pop-culture or fan festival programming experience is a strong advantage. Languages Professional English is required. Japanese and Arabic are preferred. Working Conditions Full-time and exclusive: you will be dedicated to the client for the full contract term, with no other clients or projects. Mobilisation: you must be able to mobilise within 48 hours of contract award, which is expected in October 2026. On site in Riyadh: you must be in Riyadh for the full operating periods of the summer 2027 festival (July to August) and the November 2027 event, whichever working option you choose. One position only: each candidate can be considered for one position only. A competitive package for the duration of a 14-month contract, with the potential to extend by up to 3 months Flexible working, with a remote option during the planning phase The chance to programme a flagship, multi-week festival in Riyadh for a large, diverse audience Creative ownership of main stage, community and family entertainment content A senior, hands-on role in a dedicated specialist team embedded with a major client Valuable experience on one of the region’s most high-profile live events programmes

51c2657a451c3ad3.description: Job description Our customer is hiring for the following role: وصف الوظيفة: أخصائي موارد بشرية - بان القابضة الموقع: المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية نوع العمل: دوام كامل الصناعة: السياحة والضيافة وصف الشركة: نحن في بان القابضة نؤمن بأهمية البناء والابتكار والنمو. نساهم في البناء، نعمل بابتكار، وننطلق نحو النمو المستدام. ملخص الوظيفة: نبحث عن أخصائي موارد بشرية موهوب للانضمام إلى فريقنا في المدينة المنورة. سيكون المرشح المثالي مسؤولاً عن إدارة العمليات المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك التوظيف، والتدريب، وتطوير الموظفين، وضمان الالتزام بسياسات الشركة وإجراءاتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية: - إدارة عملية التوظيف من تحديد الاحتياجات إلى اختيار المرشحين. - تطوير وتنفيذ برامج التدريب والتطوير لتعزيز مهارات الموظفين. - متابعة وتقييم أداء الموظفين وتقديم التوجيه والدعم اللازم. - ضمان الامتثال لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. - إدارة ملفات الموظفين وتحديث السجلات بشكل دوري. - المشاركة في تطوير استراتيجيات التوظيف لجذب المواهب. - تقديم المشورة والإرشاد للإدارة بشأن مسائل الموارد البشرية. المتطلبات: - درجة بكاليوس في الموارد البشرية أو إدارة الأعمال أو مجال ذي صلة. - خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية، ويفضل في صناعة السياحة والضيافة. - مهارات تواصل قوية وقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. - معرفة جيدة بالقوانين واللوائح الخاصة بالعمل. - إتقان اللغة العربية والإنجليزية. إذا كنت تبحث عن فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق مبتكر يسعى لبناء مستقبل أفضل، فإننا ندعوك للتقديم للانضمام إلى بان القابضة. تقدم الآن! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

51f2d3bc18d7a09b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بن زومة للتجارة الدولية والانماء عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل، مع ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية. توقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناشئة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. فهم عميق لمبادئ الإدارة المالية والتدفقات النقدية. القدرة على إجراء تحليل السيولة وسعر الفائدة والعملة والمخاطر المرتبطة بذلك. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات المالية المعقدة. القدرة على التنبؤ المالي وإدارة المخاطر. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاوض وتقديم الدعم. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير، ضمن فريق مالي يدعم عمليات شركة بن زومة للتجارة الدولية والانماء. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم.

51fc153799da26a8.description: About PAVIGYM PAVIGYM is a global leader in high-end gym flooring and high-performance surfaces, with over 60 years of experience and installations in more than 100 countries. The company focuses on innovation, quality, and creating effective training spaces, supported by a team that values collaboration, respect, responsibility, and positive energy. Role Overview PAVIGYM is seeking a Sales Director ME & Africa to lead the development of its distribution network, strategic accounts, and new business opportunities across the Middle East and Africa region. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on achieving sustainable and profitable growth by strengthening partnerships and creating long-term value for key customers. The role involves significant impact on the company's growth in a region with potential in the fitness sector. Key Responsibilities Lead the recruitment, development, and performance evaluation of distributors and regional partners. Formalize partnership agreements and implement a management model based on key performance indicators (pipeline, opportunity conversion, stock availability, market penetration). Ensure compliance with the company’s commercial, operational, and brand positioning standards. Develop and strengthen commercial relationships with leading operators and strategic accounts in the region. Lead the definition and execution of account development plans, including objectives, milestones, product strategy, and key decision-maker mapping. Coordinate commercial strategy and operational activity for key accounts in collaboration with regional distributors. Drive the expansion and development of new markets within the assigned territory. Identify, recruit, and develop new strategic distributors, partners, and resellers. Build collaborative relationships with industry specifiers and influencers, including architects, designers, consultants, and equipment manufacturers. Lead the development of high-value vertical segments, with a focus on Hospitality, Hotels, Wellness, and major international operators. Represent the company at trade fairs, events, and other relevant industry activities. Prepare demand forecasts and anticipate risks related to product availability and supply capacity. Coordinate technical, commercial, logistics, and service requirements with corporate teams. Act as the key link between the market and the organization, ensuring effective communication and management of priorities. Provide sales forecasts, regular reporting, and ongoing monitoring of strategic opportunities. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of experience in a relevant sales leadership role. This position requires a combination of strategic business acumen, initiative, and the ability to grow business effectively. Candidates should be confident in developing distributor networks and key accounts, comfortable in multicultural environments, and disciplined in converting market opportunities into structured projects. Clear communication, complexity management, and a focus on profitable and sustainable growth are essential. Professionalism, credibility, and positive energy are also key attributes. Compensation and Benefits PAVIGYM offers a competitive compensation package that includes a fixed salary and a variable incentive plan linked to regional performance. The role provides the opportunity to lead commercial development in a strategic international region, work with a premium product portfolio, and engage with leading fitness operators, franchise networks, and distributors across ME and Africa. The position also offers direct exposure to senior leadership within a collaborative international team. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications and are prepared to contribute to PAVIGYM’s growth in the Middle East and Africa region are encouraged to apply.

516ca3914f67c779.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينة للخدمات اللوجستية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين الميكانيكيين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، بالالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التشغيل والصيانة. المهارات والكفاءات القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات وتقديم الحلول الفعالة. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية جيدة لإعداد التقارير والوثائق. الالتزام بالمعايير والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المدينة للخدمات اللوجستية في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستتاح للمهندس فرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تدعم التطوير المهني المستمر. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الدور.

51ab58be1b7798cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من تقييم الحالة الصحية وحتى توثيق الإجراءات الطبية. ملخص المسؤوليات يتولى أخصائي التمريض مسؤولية إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييمها، بالإضافة إلى أخذ العلامات الحيوية والعينات اللازمة للفحوصات المخبرية. كما يشمل الدور إعطاء الأدوية والمواد الصيدلانية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، وتوثيق جميع الإجراءات التمريضية في السجل الطبي للمريض. المهام الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه وتوثيقها وتحليلها، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من الرعاية، وإعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب المعالج بها. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية. توثيق الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي، وضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية وتقييمها. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوثيق الطبي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية تمريضية عالية الجودة ضمن فريق طبي متخصص. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

51b5e4699546aa28.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة تحكم البناء للمقاولات العامة عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة، وتحديداً في مدينتي جدة وثول. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف على عمليات تشغيل المعدات والآليات الثقيلة، وضمان كفاءتها وسلامتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أداء الفرق العاملة في المشاريع المحددة. المشروع الحالي يركز الدور بشكل أساسي على مشروع تشغيل وصيانة (نظافة) شبكات مياه الأمطار والمياه السطحية في البلديات الفرعية. يشمل هذا المشروع مناطق ثول (THW)، ذهبان (TH)، وأبحر الشمالية (OBN)، ويتطلب إدارة فعالة للموارد والعمليات لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل المعدات والآليات والمكائن الثقيلة بكفاءة وأمان. تشحيم وتزييت الآلات والمعدات بشكل دوري، والتأكد من جاهزيتها وصلاحيتها قبل بدء العمل. متابعة أداء الآلات والمعدات بشكل مستمر، والإبلاغ عن أي أعطال أو مشكلات لقسم الصيانة. إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية المتعلقة بسير العمل، وملاحظة الأعمال والإشراف عليها. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بمختلف التحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تشغيل وإدارة المعدات الثقيلة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية ومتابعة الأداء. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والآليات. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع فرق العمل والإدارة العليا. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المحددة ضمن نطاق المشروع في جدة وثول. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

51c52f2dd8dd83a7.description: About the Role Manifest Agency is seeking an HR & Business Operations Specialist to manage the company's end-to-end HR function while supporting wider day-to-day business operations. This full-time role is based in Jeddah or Makkah and covers the full employee lifecycle, business administration, corporate documentation, accounting and invoicing support, contracts, legal coordination, and external stakeholder management. The position is suitable for a highly organized and proactive individual who thrives on ownership and offers the opportunity to develop strong HR expertise alongside broader business exposure. Key Responsibilities Human Resources Management: Manage end-to-end HR operations, including talent acquisition, onboarding, employee development, engagement, retention, and offboarding. This involves managing HR government platforms (Qiwa, GOSI, Mudad, Muqeem), preparing payroll, managing compensation and benefits, coordinating performance appraisal cycles, handling employee relations, planning engagement activities, and maintaining HR documentation and policies in compliance with Saudi Labor Law. Business Administration: Maintain corporate and administrative documentation, ensuring records are complete, organized, and accessible. This includes managing digital filing systems, tracking company licenses and registrations, coordinating government-related requirements, and supporting general office operations. Accounting Administration: Handle basic bookkeeping, maintain accounting records, and prepare client invoices. Responsibilities also include tracking payments, managing petty cash and company expenses, and coordinating with the accounting team for VAT and Zakat reporting. Legal Coordination: Prepare, maintain, and organize client contracts, NDAs, and agreements. This involves reviewing contracts for alignment with financial proposals, coordinating legal matters with management and advisors, and following up on approvals and renewals. External Stakeholder Coordination: Act as a key coordination point with external stakeholders such as production partners, suppliers, and professional service providers. This includes sourcing partners, coordinating quotations and agreements, and maintaining organized stakeholder records. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in HR and business operations. Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end HR functions. Experience with Saudi government HR platforms (Qiwa, GOSI, Mudad, Muqeem). Proficiency in managing corporate documentation and administrative tasks. Basic bookkeeping and invoicing skills. Strong organizational and coordination abilities. Skills and Attributes Highly organized and detail-oriented. Proactive and capable of taking ownership of tasks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills for managing employee relations and external stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple cross-functional responsibilities effectively. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in either Jeddah or Makkah, offering a dynamic environment where the specialist will gain exposure to various business functions and contribute to the company's operational efficiency. Why Join Manifest Agency This role provides a unique opportunity to manage a comprehensive HR function while gaining broad exposure to diverse business operations. It is suitable for professionals seeking to enhance their HR expertise and develop a holistic understanding of business integration.

51d227e37bd55a59.description: About the Role of Laboratory Technician Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Laboratory Technician to join their team. This full-time role involves performing a variety of laboratory tests and procedures to ensure accurate results across multiple disciplines. The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Purpose and Objectives The primary objective of this position is to conduct various chemistry, hematology, blood bank, serology, microscopy, and bacteriology tests and procedures. The Laboratory Technician is responsible for releasing accurate and reliable laboratory results that contribute to patient care and diagnostic processes. Key Responsibilities Receive and collect specimens under safe conditions to ensure optimal laboratory testing. Prepare specimens and apply approved analytical techniques across all laboratory areas. Accurately record results in the laboratory information system and report data. Report abnormal patient results to the senior laboratory technician or immediate supervisor prior to final release. Perform daily, weekly, and monthly equipment maintenance, troubleshoot issues as needed, and ensure the availability of spare parts. Coordinate with biomedical engineers for scheduled preventive maintenance and in cases of machine breakdown. Execute machine calibration in coordination with the senior laboratory technician. Apply Internal Quality Control (IQC) as instructed by the manufacturer and participate in the External Quality Control (EQC) Program as required by national or international accreditation organizations, referring results to the senior medical technologist/senior laboratory technician for review. Record laboratory results in designated logbooks within the assigned area. Assist in monitoring reagent and material stock levels to maintain at least two months of consumption. Participate in continuing medical education to enhance professional knowledge and competency. Contribute to person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enhance patient experience through compassion, respect, and dignity. Provide patient and family education as required. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role requires a dedicated individual capable of managing diverse laboratory tasks efficiently and accurately. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process and is not disclosed publicly.

51f00ba756ed0927.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Senior Expeditor II, I to join their team. This full-time position is responsible for overseeing assigned purchase orders to ensure all specified requirements are met, including document delivery, efficient coordination, inspections, and on-time delivery. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Expedite new, missing, or returned documents/drawings from suppliers/contractors and Engineering/Operations teams. Participate in project meetings to provide updates on the status of materials/services flow. Provide detailed updates to all stakeholders regarding the status of supplier/contractor document submittals. Offer timely information and support to internal and external stakeholders. Identify disruptions in supplier/contractor submission and delivery schedules. Maintain up-to-date delivery information through regular communication with assigned suppliers and relay it to the Project Team, ensuring updates in the project schedule. Coordinate with the IMI warehouse/project team to ensure Goods Receipt Notes (GRN)/Service Entry Sheets (SES) are completed and posted in the ERP system. Facilitate coordination between suppliers/contractors and the IMI Finance team. Verify/review documents, make necessary copies, prepare transmittal letters, and forward them to the Logistics Team. Assist suppliers of Cost & Freight (C&F) – Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) purchase orders in preparing shipping documents. Support freight forwarding through the Logistics team with exemption descriptions and documentation preparation. Assist the Logistics team in preparing required formalities for import permit applications from relevant ministries (Industry/Customs, Interior, Health), if necessary. Maintain records for customs exemptions and ensure they are up-to-date in coordination with the Logistics team. Fulfill additional responsibilities and miscellaneous expediting functions as required to support the Project. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant expediting or procurement coordination role. A strong understanding of purchase order processes, documentation requirements, and supply chain coordination is essential. Required Skills Proficiency in expediting processes and supplier management. Strong coordination and communication skills with internal and external stakeholders. Ability to identify and address potential disruptions in schedules. Experience with ERP systems for GRN/SES completion and posting. Knowledge of shipping documentation and import formalities. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills for record-keeping. Work Type This is a full-time position within International Maritime Industries.

51fd86866576f878.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

512be164f4045dd3.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise offering end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role of Senior Architect KEO International Consultants is seeking a Senior Architect to join its Project Management Division in Jeddah, KSA. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring that architectural tasks are delivered within client parameters, on time, and within budget. Key Responsibilities Maintain proper and complete communication with the client's site discipline engineers on all project-related issues. Review, understand, and implement contract drawings and specifications on-site. Prepare project reports (written and photographic) on work progress, quality, technical conformance, safety, and other relevant matters. Supervise and implement approved designs on-site in accordance with national and international codes of practice and KEO's established project management policy and procedures manual. Identify issues and risks requiring the attention of senior management. Supervise and inspect site works in progress throughout the day, as directed by senior management, continually monitoring critical areas for quality, safety, and progress. Serve as a point of contact for senior site personnel on project engineering issues. Coordinate with other project discipline engineers. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor's degree in Architectural studies. A minimum of 15 years of work experience in the field. Experience working on various large-scale mixed-use projects, including luxury hotels, diverse transport modalities, and associated utility works. Experience working in a PMC (Project Management Consultancy) or PMO (Project Management Office) environment is highly valued. Company Culture and Benefits KEO fosters a supportive environment for professional development, offering internal global mobility and career advancement opportunities. The company promotes health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees can participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. In addition to a competitive package and benefits, KEO provides policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards. Application Process KEO values integrity, results, innovation, safety, and its people, embracing diversity as a contributor to client success. All expressions of interest will be treated confidentially.

51d0c2a2413dcf6c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع كون الانجاز للصناعة عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تصميم أنظمة الألوان وأنماط الأثاث والمواد المستخدمة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد أماكن قطع الأثاث داخل المساحات الداخلية، ومباشرة تنفيذ خطط التصميم الداخلي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم للمشروعات الداخلية وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد اللازمة للتصميم. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات والقواعد واللوائح ذات الصلة، ومباشرة تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تصميم أنظمة الألوان وأنماط الأثاث. معرفة بالمواد المستخدمة في التصميم الداخلي وكيفية توظيفها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل فني التصميم الداخلي ضمن فريق متخصص في مصنع كون الانجاز للصناعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

51606d9e051847ac.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Receiving Clerk for a full-time position in Dammam, Eastern Region. This role is responsible for the accurate receiving, inspection, verification, and recording of all goods, supplies, food, beverages, and other materials delivered to the hotel. The Receiving Clerk ensures that all received items comply with approved purchase orders, specifications, quantities, quality standards, and established hotel procedures. Key Responsibilities Receive all deliveries and verify quantities, descriptions, specifications, and condition against approved Purchase Orders (POs). Inspect delivered goods for quality, damage, expiry dates, packaging, and compliance with required standards. Prepare and process receiving reports, ensuring all received items are accurately recorded in the system. Verify invoices, delivery notes, purchase orders, and receiving documents for accuracy and completeness. Report shortages, damages, discrepancies, incorrect deliveries, or rejected items to the concerned departments and suppliers. Coordinate with Purchasing, Stores, Finance, and relevant operational departments regarding deliveries and discrepancies. Ensure all received goods are properly labeled, documented, and transferred to the appropriate storage areas. Maintain accurate receiving records and ensure all documentation is properly filed and available for audit purposes. Follow hotel receiving procedures, food safety requirements, hygiene standards, and health and safety regulations. Ensure that perishable products are checked for temperature, freshness, expiry dates, and required storage conditions. Maintain the cleanliness and organization of the receiving area. Assist with periodic inventory counts and reconciliation when required. Support the Purchasing and Finance teams in resolving invoice and receiving discrepancies.
